2.204.12
StateIndicator.ToolTip
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The StateIndicator.ToolTip element specifies the tooltip text for a StateIndicator. The element can
also be used to render alternative text (alt text) that is specified as an alt attribute in an HTML report.
The StateIndicator.ToolTip element is optional. This element is ignored if it is present in any
schema version prior to RDL 2010/01. However, its data type is validated, and the value MUST be a
String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
The following is the parent element of the StateIndicator.ToolTip element.
Parent elements
StateIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the StateIndicator.ToolTip element.
 <xsd:element name="ToolTip" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
